name: OnToplist

sources.title: Homepage — active blog + US business directory; plan picker shows Standard $29.99/yr or $109.99 one-time and Business $39.99/yr or $149.99 one-time
Batch-provided submit URL — returns 404; real routes are /join/ and /add-your-business-listing/

requirements: No free tier visible: Standard Listing $29.99/yr or $109.99 one-time (social links, RSS feed, analytics); Business Listing $39.99/yr or $149.99 one-time (adds Google Maps, detailed contact info)
'Every submission is reviewed by real people' — human-reviewed, not auto-published
Two listing types: blog/site listings vs US local-business listings (name, address, contact info)
preparation: Decide listing type: Standard (site/blog) vs Business (US local business with Google Maps)
Site URL, title, description, category choice
For Business listing: address, phone, contact details
Payment method for the listing fee
workflow: Pick a plan — Standard Listing or Business Listing at /add-your-business-listing/
Wait for human review; listing appears under its category page
watchFor: Batch seed URL /add_website/ is 404 — use /join/ or /add-your-business-listing/
Source claimed 'free' — wrong; only paid tiers shown
US-local-business focus for the Business tier; Standard tier covers blogs/sites generally
Annual vs one-time pricing — one-time is better value for a permanent listing
countsAsLive: The listing appears on an ontoplist.com category page (blog directory or business directory) with a public detail page
unknowns: Whether a free tier exists behind the registration wall
